question: is the power-conformant 16-cell shape wired into the records the launcher reads, so RUN-A-STAR-2 cannot launch a shape its own card does not describe?
answer: The RECORD is now 16 cells and prices them at 1,056 against 3,192 remaining (2,136 left). The LAUNCHER is not wired: run_a_star.py reads neither GRID-PARAMS.json nor GRID-SHAPE.json, hardcodes a 10-cell CELLS tuple (run_a_star.py:99-103) and prints no price. So RUN-A-STAR-2 still cannot launch a shape its card describes -- the gap is now recorded instead of silent.
